scope:
Phone-size Chrome microphone feedback with native WAV-backed fake device.

Permission delay/denial and backend phases are controlled fixtures. MediaRecorder,
device capture, WebM production, touch events and track cleanup are native Chrome.
No physical handset, iOS, actual owner microphone, STT, Qwen or TTS is tested.
